canonical_project: VueNow Patna Master Hub Data Centre
notes: VueNow's April 2022 proposal (Rs 817 crore/USD 107m, up to 40 edge facilities across Bihar) designated a 100-rack, 1.2 MW facility in Patna as the master hub, with Darbhanga, Bhagalpur, Purnea and Buxar edge sites in phase 1. No public evidence of construction or commissioning as of 2026-08-12; DCD notes it is unclear how many VueNow facilities operate.
